fields.name: userId
fields.description: Portal user the tool account belongs to (from the caller's login, set by link-complete).

fields.name: email
fields.description: The tool account's email, lowercased. Unique per tool (index tool_email_unique).

fields.name: method
fields.description: How ownership was proven: google | microsoft | email-code

fields.name: providerSubject
fields.description: The provider's subject id (sub) for google / microsoft; null for email-code.

fields.name: verifiedAt
fields.description: UTC time the proof was checked.
